text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or had been tending to the
flowers all by herself.
Even if all I could do was watch over her,
as her Trainer—
choice_data_list: I can't stay completely clueless a...
I can't stay completely clueless a...

text_block_list.text:
Thinking this,
I set off today for a botanical garden in
the next town, renowned for its flowers.
Upon arriving at the nearest bus stop,
who should be there but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer?
What brings you... to a place like this?
choice_data_list: Bouquet... are you heading to the ...
Bouquet... are you heading to the ...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My goodness—are you as well, Trainer?
What an incredible coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately,
though—
it seems the bus schedule has temporarily
changed, so we'll have to wait a while.
choice_data_list: Oh, really...?

text_block_list.text:
A few unexpected turns...
but maybe this is fate.
Besides,
viewing flowers together with her will surely
teach me a lot.
choice_data_list: If you don't mind... may I wait fo...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—of course.
Since we're here, let's have a nice,
relaxing chat.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard about their beautiful flower fields
and was curious for a while...
It's quite far from the academy,
so this is my first time visiting.
choice_data_list: I've started getting interested in...
I've started getting interested in...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My—is that so?
...Fufu, I see.
(Peep, peep...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... look over there, a kingfisher.
Such a lovely lapis lazuli color—
how charming.
choice_data_list: Yeah... I could watch it forever.
Yeah... I could watch it forever.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—!
...Um, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You'll surely love baby blue eyes!
Just like the kingfisher, they're tiny,
stunning blue flowers—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah......
...I-I'm so sorry.
You mentioned you'd become interested in
flowers, so—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I got carried away wanting to share so much
with you...
...That was a bit overbearing of me,
wasn't it?
choice_data_list: No, not at all! It really helps! T...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so? What a relief... Um—
Once we arrive,
I'd love to search for baby blue eyes together
with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Roses should be in full bloom around this
time, too.
Azaleas, lavender as well—oh?
choice_data_list: Wait, the bus is already here?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That was faster than expected...
I'm sorry,
I feel like I did all the talking.
choice_data_list: Not at all, you've made me look fo...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—I'm looking forward to it as well.
—Shall we get on the bus?

And so, after a sway of the bus ride,
we arrived at the botanical garden reception,
but...
choice_data_list: Huh, we can't go in yet today?

text_block_list.name: Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry,
our lighting inspection is taking longer
than expected...
We anticipate it will be about another hour
before visitors can enter...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... what should we do?
I don't mind waiting, but—
choice_data_list: If you're fine with it, Bouquet, l...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—in that case, I'll go grab a brochure.
Let's sit over on that bench and read it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Most botanical gardens like this replant
their flowers each season.
It says here,
'Experience the changing of nature through
our blossoms'—
choice_data_list: I see... Then you could enjoy comi...
I see... Then you could enjoy comi...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Hehe, that's true.
The flowers at their peak change with every
season, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Autumn brings—autumn foliage, of course,
along with dahlias and cosmos—
a time when so many vivid blossoms burst
into bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And even in the bitter winter—quietly,
beautiful flowers will blossom.
Just looking at camellias and cyclamens—
makes my heart feel warm.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The cycle of seasons is long, but—
there are so many wonderful things to look
forward to within it.
choice_data_list: Yeah, definitely... *sigh*
Yeah, definitely... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Trainer, are you feeling hot?
We've been talking a lot,
let me get you a drink—
choice_data_list: Oh, about that—

text_block_list.text:
I pull out a bottled drink I bought at the
reception desk from my bag.
Thinking she must be thirsty,
I offer it to her—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Here,
I bought this at the reception earlier—
huh?
choice_data_list: Wait... you bought one too, Bouquet?
Wait... you bought one too, Bouquet?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I was just worried that you might be hot,
Trainer...
choice_data_list: I was thinking you might be thirst...
I was thinking you might be thirst...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah...... oh—so that's what happened...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
shall we swap our water and drink?
choice_data_list: ...Haha, sounds good.
...Haha, sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for waiting, everyone!
We've finished our inspection,
so you may now enter the park.
choice_data_list: Oh, is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That went by surprisingly fast—
shall we head inside, then?
We've finally reached today's destination.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...!
Every single one of them—
is so vivid and beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Are those yellow ones gerberas,
I wonder...?
And further back,
I can see red poppies too—!
choice_data_list: This is... truly amazing...!
This is... truly amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—that's right, the nemophilas!
Trainer, let's go find them...!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go!
Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Wah—there they are, Trainer!
Look,
so many tiny little flowers—
they're utterly adorable.
choice_data_list: You're right, they're so cute!
You're right, they're so cute!

text_block_list.text:
Strolling through the gardens after that
and taking in the gorgeous flowers...
I felt like I could truly understand her
love for blooming blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's already starting to get dark,
isn't it?
Even though the sun was shining so brightly
just a little while ago—
choice_data_list: Well, a lot happened today, after all.
Well, a lot happened today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah—hehe, that's true.
We spent quite a long time waiting before
we could see the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even so—
it wasn't a chore in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Really............ not at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Getting to chat with you, Trainer—
made the scenery here feel so much more
vivid in my mind. And—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It ended up far exceeding—
anything I could have imagined.
choice_data_list: ...Let's come here together again!
...Let's come here together again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, yes.
—I can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
There's about 20 minutes until the bus back
arrives.
Looks like we won't have to wait as long as
on the way here.

Even so, waiting for the bus again...
it seems like it'll still take quite a while
to get back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If you'd like—could we chat some more?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
On the way back—
I'd love to hear your stories.
About the flowers you came to like today.
And—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...even if it's not about flowers,
anything is fine.
choice_data_list: Bouquet... yeah, of course!
Bouquet... yeah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Hehe. Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this ride...
will feel like it's over in no time too.

And so,
the two of us chatted away while waiting
for the bus.
By the time we finally arrived near the
academy, the sun had nearly set—

The sunset we looked up at together—
somehow seemed even more beautiful than
usual.
